'''Magnus Larsson''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 64 FL from Lund, Sweden. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. [[Winfried Sommerfeld]] (Red 41) named him among the friends he made through Star Wars CCG.<ref name="decsq-sommerfeld">[http://decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 41], decipher.com (page last modified 28 June 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023104822/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
